faqs.q: When should I complete a letter of authority?
faqs.a: You need a letter of authority if you want to nominate someone within your business who is not listed as an associate on the ABR to act on behalf of your business, or if you want your accountant, tax agent, or BAS agent to act on your behalf.

faqs.q: What information must I include in the letter of authority?
faqs.a: The letter must be created on your business letterhead and include the necessary details for your business and your specific details.

faqs.q: Who can use sample text B?
faqs.a: Sample text B is for qualified accountants, registered tax agents, or registered BAS agents who are acting on behalf of a client who has asked them to register for a grant, scheme, or support program administered by Service NSW.
